kol.take: 模型能力仍受底层计算效率与供给约束；硬件、系统软件和推理优化共同决定可交付的速度与成本。
kol.take_en: Model economics still depend on compute efficiency and supply; hardware, systems software and inference optimization jointly determine speed and cost.
kol.take_zh: OpenAI 正在从模型开发转向全栈布局，通过大规模购买算力及研发 Jalapeno 芯片构建护城河。其目标极为宏大，计划实现每周建设 1GW 新能源产能的规模，以支撑日益增长的算力需求。
kol.detail: My guest today is Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI. It's a conversation spanning the history, present, and future of OpenAI, from the origin of ChatGPT through Codex, hardware, and their new Jalapeno chip. We discuss the early decision to buy compute at a scale nobody thought was rational, and the plan to build a gigawatt of new capacity every week. We talk about Kimi and distillation, the Hugging Face incident and what it means for the pace of AI development, and what it's like to raise kids who will grow up never knowing a world without abundant intelligence. Please enjoy my conversation with Sam A...
kol.detail_zh: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 在访谈中探讨了公司的发展历程及未来愿景，涵盖从 ChatGPT 和 Codex 的起源到硬件领域布局的规划，包括其研发的 Jalapeno 芯片。Altman 强调了 OpenAI 早期大规模购买算力的战略决策，并提出了每周建设 1GW 新产能的宏大计划。对话还涉及了模型蒸馏、Hugging Face 事件对 AI 发展速度的影响，以及人工智能普及后社会未来的智能化变革。

kol.take: agent 价值正在从一次性生成转向长期工作流；状态管理、成本归因、工具调用和反馈闭环会决定 token 消耗与产品粘性。
kol.take_en: Agent value is moving from one-shot generation to durable workflows; state, cost attribution, tool use and feedback loops drive token usage and stickiness.
kol.take_zh: 当前人才市场正出现剧烈的两极分化，招聘市场正处于 AI 原生开发者与实干型管理者的牛市，而传统部门负责人却深陷熊市；管理一个由 10 个 AI 智能体组成的团队，其价值正逐渐超越管理百人规模传统团队的经验。
kol.detail: re: hiring right now it's a huge bull market for AI-native IC's/player-coaches it's a huge bear market for "heads of X" managers never seen such furious bifurcation. to oversimplify: 1 year experience managing 10 agents > 10 years experience managing 10-100 people
kol.detail_zh: 当前 AI 人才市场呈现剧烈的两极分化：对于能够直接上手、具备 AI 原生能力的个体贡献者（IC）或实干型管理者而言，正处于极大的牛市；而传统的“部门负责人”等纯管理岗位则面临严峻的熊市。这种分化的核心逻辑在于，管理 10 个 AI Agent 的一年经验，其价值正逐渐超越管理 10 到 100 人团队的十年传统管理经验。

kol.take: 模型商业化要看真实路由和 $ spend 份额，而不是只看 benchmark；渠道份额能更早暴露谁在生产流量里变现。
kol.take_en: Model monetization is better tracked through real routing and $ spend share than benchmarks; channel share reveals who is monetizing production traffic.
kol.take_zh: 尽管 Claude Code 的核心能力模式在今年呈现出“意外开源”的态势，但并未对 Anthropic 或其竞争对手的产品路线图产生实质性冲击。这表明当前的 Agent 路由与演进逻辑具备极强的产业韧性。
kol.detail: as the progenitor of the agent lab thesis which got the evals/routing/interactivity/ROI focus right i gotta say the biggest argument against myself is that Claude Code got accidentally "open sourced" this year and approximately ~nothing happened to either it or its competitors' roadmaps
kol.detail_zh: Swyx 指出，尽管此前 Agent Lab 的核心论点集中在评估、路由、交互性和投资回报率（ROI）上，但 Claude Code 今年“意外”开源（指其能力及模式公开化）这一事实，并未对 Claude 或其竞争对手的产品路线图产生实质性的冲击或改变。这表明目前的模型路由与 Agent 演进逻辑在面对这类工具的冲击时表现出了极强的韧性。

kol.take: agent 越能自主改代码，底层 runtime 越需要确定性、隔离与恢复能力；更快的生成速度反而提高了工程约束的重要性。
kol.take_en: As agents gain autonomy over code, runtimes need more determinism, isolation and recovery; faster generation raises the value of engineering constraints.
kol.take_zh: Kimi 的最新研究强调了为 AI 智能体构建安全边界的重要性，实验显示仅靠容器级隔离不足以防止故障。由于智能体可能通过内核错误导致底层机器崩溃，因此采用 Firecracker 微型虚拟机是确保安全运行的有效方案。
kol.detail: Kimi's paper underlines the importance of the right security boundary for agents to run in. tl:DR: container-level isolation is not enough. In their experiments, agents crashed the underlying machine (via kernel panics). Firecracker microVMs (as in Vercel Sandbox) are safe.
kol.detail_zh: Guillermo Rauch 指出 Kimi 的研究强调了为 AI Agent 构建正确安全边界的重要性。实验表明，仅靠容器级隔离（container-level isolation）不足以保证安全，Agent 甚至可能导致底层机器崩溃（kernel panics）。相比之下，使用 Firecracker 微型虚拟机（如 Vercel Sandbox 所采用的技术）才能确保运行安全性。

kol_archive.take: agent 价值正在从一次性生成转向长期工作流；状态管理、成本归因、工具调用和反馈闭环会决定 token 消耗与产品粘性。

kol_archive.take_zh: Opus 5 在编程、数据分析及生物学等高阶知识领域表现卓越。最核心的突破在于通过强化模型对齐与 Claude Code 自动模式，将其面临的提示词注入（Prompt Injection）攻击成功率降至接近 0。
kol_archive.detail: Opus 5 is a great model for coding, data analysis, design, biology, knowledge work. More than any of these eval scores, what is most exciting to me is something else: Opus 5 is our least prompt injectable model yet. It is a bit buried in the system card, but across PI evals and red teaming, Opus 5 is very hard to prompt inject successfully. And when layering defenses -- strong model alignment, combined with prompt injection probes, combined with Auto Mode in Claude Code -- the success rate for prompt injection attacks drops to ~0. This is new and exciting! More about this soon.
kol_archive.detail_zh: Opus 5 在编程、数据分析、设计及生物学等知识工作领域表现出色。其最显著的进步在于安全性大幅提升，通过强化模型对齐、提示词注入探测以及 Claude Code 中的自动模式，其提示词注入（Prompt Injection）攻击的成功率已降至接近 0。

kol_archive.detail: Based on internal evals: ▪️ Kimi K3 is top-tier at cybersecurity There is chatter on X that Moonshot benchmark-overfit. These are stealth evals. Model has raw IQ. ▪️ Sol is a leap ahead in cyber capability At a significantly higher cost, but quite remarkable still. ▪️ Fable refuses everything We couldn’t get it to complete the run at all. What’s interesting is that Sol in comparison was much more open to helping with defensive cyber hardening TL;DR: frontier, open-weight cybersecurity capability is here. Try it on for defensive purposes.
kol_archive.detail_zh: Guillermo Rauch 内部测评显示：Kimi K3 网络安全能力顶尖且具原始智力，非刷榜结果；Sol 攻防能力跃升虽成本高但配合防御加固度高；Fable 则全程拒绝执行。结论指出前沿开放权重模型已具备实战级网安能力，建议用于防御目的。
